fusions.name: Pitch Shriek
fusions.desc: Looses a narrow shriek 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 resonating damage to everything in it, stuns them for 1 second and leaves them [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Night Darts
fusions.desc: Fires a dart of darkness that deals 7 dark damage to the first enemy it meets. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Erratic Flight
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds and jinks you 3 tiles from where you stood. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Answer from the Dark
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
